title: AIUseCaseIntake
description: Intake record for an AI or model use case in financial services. The front-door artefact of the AI governance pipeline. Consumed by ai-risk-tiering, ai-act-triage, model-card-builder, validation-plan, agentic-ai-controls, vendor-diligence (TPRM), genai-pre-prod-review, and the AI inventory of record.

use_case_id.description: Canonical firm ID for the use case. Stable across intake versions; downstream skills key off this.

use_case_version.description: Intake-record version. The intake is a living record; downstream tier and card decisions are decided against a named version.

use_case_name.description: Short human-readable name. Plain English; no marketing language.

engagement_scope_id.description: Links to engagement-scoping record if supplied.

next_review_due.description: Date by which this intake record should be re-reviewed against the change plan.

accountable_owner_role.description: First-line accountable owner role (a role, never a named individual).

ai_governance_lead_reviewer.description: Second-line reviewer role (e.g., AI Governance Lead).

lifecycle_stage.description: Where the use case is in the lifecycle. Drives evidence weights.

purpose_statement.description: One paragraph in plain language: what the use case does, what business outcome it supports, why this approach over the alternative.

user_role.description: Internal staff role, customer segment, third-party role, or agentic caller.

decision_influenced.description: What the use case influences for this user role.

human_review_point.description: Where the human review point sits in the flow for this user role.

evidence_of_effective_oversight.description: Evidence the human review point is effective oversight (NIST Map 3.5 / EU AI Act Article 14), not rubber-stamp at scale. Use [evidence needed] when absent.

foundation_model.description: Required when model_type is foundation_model or agentic.

actions.description: What actions this tool can take.

field_level_tagging.description: Required for any source flagged regulated_npi, regulated_phi, regulated_pci, or biometric. Names the regulated field categories within the source.

lawful_basis.description: Lawful basis or consent posture where applicable.

criticality.description: Operational-resilience criticality, not the model-risk tier.

fallback_posture.description: Firm-side fallback if the vendor exits or fails.

regulatory_flags.description: Tags for the named regulators and rules this use case touches. Each flag carries a one-line basis and a routing destination.

flag.description: Named regulator or rule (e.g., SR_11_7, OCC_2026_13, EU_AI_Act_Annex_III_5b, EU_AI_Act_Article_17, NYDFS_Part_500, NYDFS_AI_letter_2024, CFPB_Circular_2022_03, NAIC_Bulletin_AI_2023, CO_SB_21_169, NY_DFS_Circular_AI_2024, SEC_Marketing_Rule, SEC_204_2_books_records, FFIEC_BSA_AML, GLBA_Safeguards, HIPAA, OCC_2023_17_third_party, July_2024_bank_fintech).

routes_to.description: Downstream skill that picks up the flag (e.g., ai-risk-tiering, ai-act-triage, model-card-builder, validation-plan, agentic-ai-controls, vendor-diligence, llm-vendor-evidence-review).

preliminary_tier.description: Sponsor or first-line proposal of tier. The formal tier is decided downstream by ai-risk-tiering against this intake record.

gate.description: Independent validation, AI risk committee approval, pre-prod gate, vendor diligence, monitoring cadence, complaint surveillance.

stop_condition.description: What halts the use case if the gate fails.

open_questions.description: Items needing second-line follow-up. Each tagged with the downstream skill that needs the answer.

routes_to.description: Downstream skill: ai-risk-tiering, ai-act-triage, model-card-builder, validation-plan, agentic-ai-controls, vendor-diligence, prompt-injection-risk, rag-evaluation-review, genai-pre-prod-review, llm-vendor-evidence-review.

change_plan.description: Twelve-month change plan. Avoids the moving-target failure mode where tier and gates set on a snapshot drift within a quarter.

autonomy_uplift.description: Planned autonomy changes (e.g., adding tool use, reducing human-in-the-loop).

items.description: Sector and cross-cutting overlays applied (e.g., banking, insurance, capital-markets, payments-fintech, cyber, privacy, conduct).

ai_act_overlap.description: Whether the use case overlaps with EU AI Act high-risk categorisation. Formal classification owned by ai-act-triage.

provider_or_deployer_role.description: Provider obligations include Article 17 quality management; deployer obligations include Articles 26 and 27.

source.description: Intake conversation, sponsor memo, vendor proposal, system design document, vendor system card, prior intake version, or [evidence needed].

reviewer_attestation.description: Filled by the AI Governance Lead. The intake is filed only after attestation.

onward_routing.description: Downstream skills the intake routes to (ai-risk-tiering, ai-act-triage, model-card-builder, validation-plan, agentic-ai-controls, vendor-diligence, etc.).
